caption: Campaigns stay locked until the Reviewers core script is switched on in the theme; after saving, the app showed the embed as active.
Step 1 of the free campaign: 10 items to give away, and only products with at least 15 units in stock can be picked.
Step 2: age range and gender; the reviewer location is fixed to the US.
Step 7 before submitting: 10 items, women 18 to 65 in the US, request 7 days after fulfillment, billed as free. We did not submit.
Price table on reviewers.com: $150 per campaign of up to 10 items, down to $120 per campaign at 20 a month.
